steps: Resolve intended world/client/grid and only consequential missing details. GM browser dimensions do not identify TV viewport.

Read authenticated target readiness. Updated companion source additionally reports CSS canvas dimensions, DPR and actual canvas readiness; require fresh evidence after deployment or label preview profile. Revalidate after resize/reconnect.
For physical miniatures calibrate actual physical screen dimensions/on-screen measurement and zoom; ask which priority if full-map fit conflicts with physical cell size.
Prefer suitable owned/licensed gridless asset. No arbitrary web-image license assumption, paid acquisition or generated fallback. Generation provider/allowance/cost needs approval before submission.

Preserve aspect ratio/tactical geometry using explicit fit/padding/crop; disclose panning. Remove private labels/secret annotations from player-visible image; baked grid must be calibrated or declined rather than doubled.

Prepare draft scene without activation/combat/initiative; set native grid type,size,distance,units,image offsets and rows/columns consistently. Grid alignment updates only size,distance,offsets, not every scene field.
Verify scene/grid readback and provenance/calibration, return preview. Applying player viewport/display needs explicit request or approved workflow. No walls/lighting/doors/tokens inferred.
Keep external acquisition outside mutation queue; cancellation/retries must revalidate authority/state before scene commit, retain confirmed created scene IDs and avoid duplicate drafts.
evidence: Confirmed draft scene/grid configuration plus intended-client acknowledgement; actual TV preview and feedback required for digital/physical acceptance.
